# Command reference

Every command and option of `eichhorn`. For a guided start see [Getting started](getting-started.md).

## Global options

```text
usage: eichhorn [-h] [--version] [--config DIR] [--json] [--quiet] [--allow-sleep] COMMAND ...
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--version` | show program's version number and exit |
| `--config` `DIR` | config folder (default: the platform's config folder, or $EICHHORN_CONFIG) |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |
| `--quiet`, `-q` | less output |
| `--allow-sleep` | do not keep the computer awake during long runs |

## `eichhorn repo init`

Make a folder on a drive into a repository.

```text
eichhorn repo init [-h] --name NAME [--storage {hardlinks,sparse}] path
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | folder for the repository, e.g. /Volumes/Backup-A/eichhorn |
| `--name` `NAME` | a short name, e.g. Backup-A |
| `--storage` `hardlinks\|sparse` | override the detected storage mode |

## `eichhorn repo list`

List repositories and whether they are connected.

```text
eichhorn repo list [-h]
```

## `eichhorn repo scan`

Rebuild the local cache from a repository.

```text
eichhorn repo scan [-h] [repo]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `repo` | repository name (default: all connected) |

## `eichhorn repo sync`

Copy missing snapshots from one repository to another.

```text
eichhorn repo sync [-h] [--target T] [--both] [--dry-run] [--no-prune] [--include-older] SRC DST
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SRC` |  |
| `DST` |  |
| `--target` `T` | only this target (repeatable) |
| `--both` | sync in both directions |
| `--dry-run` | only show what would be copied |
| `--no-prune` | do not prune the destination |
| `--include-older` | also copy snapshots older than the destination's oldest |

## `eichhorn repo unlock`

Remove a stale lock.

```text
eichhorn repo unlock [-h] [--force] repo
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `repo` | repository name |
| `--force` | also remove a lock that may be in use |

## `eichhorn target list`

List targets and their last backup.

```text
eichhorn target list [-h]
```

## `eichhorn target new`

Create a commented target file.

```text
eichhorn target new [-h] [--recipe RECIPE] name
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` |  |
| `--recipe` `RECIPE` | start from a recipe (see `eichhorn recipe list`) |

## `eichhorn target show`

Print a target's config.

```text
eichhorn target show [-h] [--expanded] name
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` |  |
| `--expanded` | with its recipe filled in |

## `eichhorn config check`

Validate all config files.

```text
eichhorn config check [-h]
```

## `eichhorn run`

Back up targets.

```text
eichhorn run [-h] [--all] [--repo NAME] [--all-repos] [--label LABEL] [--pin] [--dry-run] [--restart] [--no-prune] [TARGET ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TARGET` |  |
| `--all` | all targets |
| `--repo` `NAME` | repository to write to |
| `--all-repos` | every connected repository the target belongs to |
| `--label` `LABEL` | a note for the new snapshot |
| `--pin` | never prune the new snapshot |
| `--dry-run` | show what would be copied |
| `--restart` | throw away an unfinished run instead of resuming it |
| `--no-prune` | do not prune after the run |

## `eichhorn doctor`

Check targets' hosts, tools and databases.

```text
eichhorn doctor [-h] [TARGET ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TARGET` | default: all targets |

## `eichhorn recipe list`

List recipes and their parameters.

```text
eichhorn recipe list [-h]
```

## `eichhorn prune`

Delete old snapshots according to the retention rules.

```text
eichhorn prune [-h] [--repo NAME] [--dry-run] [TARGET ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TARGET` | default: all targets |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |
| `--dry-run` | only show what would be deleted |

## `eichhorn pin`

Never prune a snapshot.

```text
eichhorn pin [-h] [--repo NAME] [--note NOTE] target snapshot
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `snapshot` | snapshot name, a unique prefix of it, or latest |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |
| `--note` `NOTE` | why it is pinned |

## `eichhorn unpin`

Allow pruning again.

```text
eichhorn unpin [-h] [--repo NAME] target snapshot
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `snapshot` | snapshot name, a unique prefix of it, or latest |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |

## `eichhorn label`

Set or remove a snapshot's label.

```text
eichhorn label [-h] [--repo NAME] target snapshot text
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `snapshot` | snapshot name, a unique prefix of it, or latest |
| `text` | the label; an empty text removes it |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |

## `eichhorn diff`

What changed between two snapshots.

```text
eichhorn diff [-h] [--repo NAME] target [SNAP_A] [SNAP_B]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `SNAP_A` | default: the second newest |
| `SNAP_B` | default: the newest |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |

## `eichhorn find`

Find a file in all snapshots and show its versions.

```text
eichhorn find [-h] [--repo NAME] [--limit LIMIT] target pattern
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `pattern` | a name or glob, e.g. report.docx, '*.jpg', 'docs/*/a.txt' |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | show at most N files |

## `eichhorn restore`

Copy files out of a snapshot.

```text
eichhorn restore [-h] --to DEST [--force] [--sudo] [--repo NAME] target snapshot [path]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `snapshot` | snapshot name, a unique prefix of it, or latest |
| `path` | file or folder in the snapshot (default: everything) |
| `--to` `DEST` | a local folder, or host:/path to restore onto a server |
| `--force` | overwrite existing files |
| `--sudo` | unpack with sudo on the server |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |

## `eichhorn dump`

Write a database dump from a snapshot, uncompressed.

```text
eichhorn dump [-h] [--to FILE] [--force] [--repo NAME] target snapshot name
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `snapshot` | snapshot name, a unique prefix of it, or latest |
| `name` | the dump's name in the target config |
| `--to` `FILE` | write to FILE (default: standard output) |
| `--force` | overwrite FILE |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |

## `eichhorn verify`

Check snapshots against their checksums.

```text
eichhorn verify [-h] [--all] [--all-snapshots] [--sample PCT] [--against-source] [--repo NAME] [target] [snapshot]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `snapshot` | default: latest |
| `--all` | all targets |
| `--all-snapshots` | every snapshot |
| `--sample` `PCT` | check a random PCT %% of files |
| `--against-source` | also compare the snapshot with the host |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |

## `eichhorn stats`

Statistics of a repository, a target or a snapshot.

```text
eichhorn stats [-h] [--repo NAME] [target] [snapshot]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
| `snapshot` |  |
| `--repo` `NAME` |  |

## `eichhorn serve`

Start the web interface.

```text
eichhorn serve [-h] [--listen ADDR] [--no-browser]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--listen` `ADDR` | address (default: 127.0.0.1:8765) |
| `--no-browser` | do not open a browser |

## `eichhorn status`

Last backup of each target in each repository.

```text
eichhorn status [-h]
```

List the snapshots of a target.

```text

```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` |  |
